facts.content: Patient reports bad diarrhoea.
Patient has had 3 days of watery or loose stools occurring 4 to 5 times per day.
Patient reports mild abdominal pain.
Patient had one episode of vomiting.
Patient has slightly decreased appetite.
Patient is able to maintain fluid intake.
There is a possible low-grade fever.
Patient reports no blood or mucus in the stool.
Patient reports no recent travel or dietary trigger.
facts.source_text: no recent travel or dietary trigger

facts.content: Patient has a history of asthma.
Patient uses a yellow Lexapro inhaler.
Patient has no known drug allergies.
Patient's father had hypertension.
Patient's father died of bowel cancer at age 62.
Social history was not discussed in this consultation.
Patient appears well hydrated on video examination.
Assessment is acute self-limited diarrhoea, suspected viral gastroenteritis, with no red-flag features.
facts.source_text: 1. Acute self-limited diarrhoea, ?viral gastroenteritis, no red-flag features

facts.content: Asthma is assessed as stable.
For diarrhoea, patient may use oral rehydration solution (Dioralyte) as needed.
Patient is advised to follow a soft diet including toast, crackers, and mashed vegetables.
Patient is advised to avoid dairy except yoghurt, and to avoid meat, egg, and fish until 48 hours after being symptom-free.
facts.source_text: avoid dairy (except yoghurt), meat, egg, fish until 48 h symptom-free

facts.content: Patient should return or seek care if diarrhoea lasts more than one week.
Patient should return or seek care if stool frequency reaches six to eight or more stools per day.
Patient should return or seek care if there is blood or mucus in the stool.
Patient should return or seek care if fever increases.
Patient should return or seek care if there are signs of dehydration, which may lead to stool sample testing and possible hospital evaluation.
facts.source_text: signs dehydration → stool sample ± hospital eval

facts.content: For asthma, patient should continue the current inhaler.
Patient was advised that instructions are recorded in the app and encouraged to review them.
facts.source_text: Pt advised instructions recorded in app; encouraged to review
